mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, increasing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns exhibit a negative or insignificant rank correlation (Rank IC < 0.03) with FEDFUNDS level over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and heightened recession risk, prompting equity investors to reduce risk exposure and generate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening of consumer and housing demand, which typically precedes a recession and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC between the joint signal and returns is negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) growth signals an impending economic peak, prompting equity investors to reduce exposure and generate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO growth decelerates, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is positive (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 1-year rolling window in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show no positive correlation with HOUST level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically precedes a recession and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is positive (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC between the joint signal and returns is positive (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery, a strong increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates accelerating economic activity and improved corporate earnings prospects, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during labor market recoveries when PAYEMS growth is strong, or the Rank IC between PAYEMS and returns is negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 1-year rolling window in the recovery regime.
